diagrams.title: Workbench session lifecycle
diagrams.summary: The runtime initializes the store, coordinates actions, and preserves idempotent recovery.

nodes.label: Boot
nodes.description: Configuration, registries, and dependencies are prepared.

nodes.label: Workbench store
nodes.description: The composite session state is created.

nodes.label: Admitted action
nodes.description: The shell, a mode, or a tool receives an intent.

nodes.label: Persistence and synchronization
nodes.description: Layout, focus, and history are captured.

nodes.label: Recovery
nodes.description: The session is rehydrated without duplication.

diagrams.caption: The Workbench runtime coordinates hosted domains without inventing their product meaning.
